अरे यारो, फराह खान के घर में आग लगने की झूठी खबर पर भड़क गया पूरा इंटरनेट! 🔥
रविवार को एक वीडियो वायरल हुआ जिसमें दावा किया गया कि फराह खान के मुंबई के Lokhandwala स्थित Oberoi Sky Heights वाले घर में आग लग गई है।
लेकिन फराह ने Instagram पर वीडियो शेयर करके साफ किया कि आग उनके घर में नहीं बल्कि एक under-construction building में लगी थी।
फराह ने ऑनलाइन पोर्टल्स को खरी-खोटी सुनाते हुए कहा कि क्लिकबेट के चक्कर में कुछ भी मत छापो, थोड़ा जिम्मेदार बनो! 🛑
इसके अलावा फराह ने यह भी बताया कि उन्होंने अपनी अगली फिल्म की स्क्रिप्ट पूरी कर ली है और वह दिसंबर में शूटिंग शुरू करेंगी, लेकिन तभी जब Shah Rukh Khan उस फिल्म में काम करेंगे।
साथ ही फराह के YouTube vlogs और उनके cook Dilip की कहानी ने भी सोशल मीडिया पर धूम मचा रखी है, जिनकी कमाई से दिलीप कर्ज-मुक्त हो गए हैं! 🎥
तो दोस्तों, क्या आपको लगता है कि ऑनलाइन चैनल्स को बिना सच जाने ऐसी झूठी खबरें नहीं फैलानी चाहिए? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Farah Khan slams ‘clickbait’ videos about fire at her Mumbai residence, urges online portals to be responsible
ctx.summary: Farah Khan urged online portals to verify reports after a viral video claimed a fire had broken out at her Mumbai home.
ctx.text:
Filmmaker and choreographer Farah Khan has called out online portals for circulating a video claiming that a fire broke out at her residence in Mumbai, leaving fans worried. The filmmaker urged digital platforms to act responsibly and verify details before publishing such reports.
On Sunday, a video surfaced online claiming that Farah Khan's apartment had caught fire. However, Farah took to Instagram and shared the video, criticising the reports while clarifying that the fire had broken out in an under-construction building and not her home.
She wrote, "Online portals plss BE RESPONSIBLE!! This is an under-construction building!! Clickbait can't be everything!" Farah lives at Oberoi Sky Heights in Lokhandwala, Mumbai. There have been no official reports of injuries or major damage to her property in connection with the viral claims.
Farah recently had her bedroom revamped after her friend and filmmaker Karan Johar nominated her for a bedroom makeover. The makeover involved replacing the old flooring with wooden floors and adding textured chocolate-brown and marble-effect walls, giving the room a sophisticated look while concealing damp patches. A separate wardrobe and vanity area were also created using floor-to-ceiling sliding panels with fingerprint- and password-enabled locks.
Farah is currently busy with her YouTube vlogs, which she started making in 2024. The vlogs quickly gained popularity because of her fun bond with her cook, Dilip. Their candid conversations made him a social media sensation. The filmmaker and choreographer has revealed that her YouTube earnings helped Dilip become debt-free. He has also gone on to feature in several advertisements alongside Shah Rukh Khan and other stars. Farah and Dilip continue to visit celebrities' homes and introduce their audience to a new recipe in each vlog.
In a recent conversation with Neha Dhupia and Angad Bedi, Farah revealed why she decided to explore YouTube. She said that after completing the script of her next film, she had some time before filming began. The filmmaker therefore decided to explore YouTube but was certain that she did not want to start a podcast. She explained that the film industry often makes people insecure, as artists constantly compare themselves with others, and she did not want to be part of that environment.
Farah revealed that she has completed the script of her next film and will begin shooting in December this year. She said she would make her next film only if Shah Rukh Khan starred in it; otherwise, she would wait for his dates. The actor and filmmaker have previously collaborated on hits and blockbusters such as Main Hoon Na, Om Shanti Om and Happy New Year. Their upcoming project would mark their fourth collaboration.
